questions.text: How are you really feeling today, beyond the surface?
questions.verse_text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

questions.text: When did things start feeling so heavy?
questions.verse_text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

questions.text: Is getting through each day a struggle right now?
questions.verse_text: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

questions.text: Are there moments, even brief ones, where you feel any lightness?
questions.verse_text: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

questions.text: Do you feel disconnected from God in this season?
questions.verse_text: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring? O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

questions.text: Have you been able to talk to anyone about how you're feeling?
questions.verse_text: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

questions.text: What is one small thing that brought you comfort recently, even just a little?
questions.verse_text: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort; Who comforteth us in all our tribulation.

questions.text: If you could ask God one question right now, what would it be?
questions.verse_text: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me? How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily?

questions.text: Can you hold onto the truth that this darkness is not forever?
questions.verse_text: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee. For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

questions.text: Would you like me to just sit here with you for a moment? You don't have to say anything.
questions.verse_text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

session_flow.special_note: Depression sessions should move very slowly and offer frequent pauses. Always check for crisis indicators.

crisis_indicators.action: Immediately show crisis resources and validate their courage in sharing
